title: Role Play
tagline: Step into a role. Unlock another perspective.
shortDescription: Each participant gets a secret role on their phone, with a goal, tasks, and hidden questions. Together they debate, persuade, and vote, and only at the end does everyone see how the roles shaped the result.
longDescription: A role-based group experience played on participants' own phones. Everyone receives a character with a secret goal, for example to push one side of a debate, to stay open, or to win others over, and then joins a shared chat where tasks, prompts, and secret questions appear during the round. A final vote shows the outcome, and revealing all roles turns it into a conversation about how opinions form and how persuasion works. It suits workshops, school classes, museums, and team events, and can be played as a debate, an imposter game, or a story-driven mission. Topics, roles, tasks, timing, and languages are configurable. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Learning by Playing a Part
highlights.description: Taking on a role makes people argue positions they would never choose themselves, which opens up new perspectives far better than a lecture.

highlights.title: Everyone Plays on Their Own Phone
highlights.description: Nothing to install and no hardware to hand out: participants join with their own phones, and a whole class or team is playing within minutes.

highlights.title: The Reveal Starts the Conversation
highlights.description: When the roles are revealed at the end, the group sees how polarisers and followers steered the vote, a natural starting point for reflection and debriefing.

highlights.title: Plot Twists
highlights.description: Add an imposter that the others must unmask, roles that change mid-round, secret alliances, or a moderator who drops new information into the chat at key moments.

highlights.title: Any Topic, Any Group
highlights.description: Debate pineapple on pizza to break the ice, explore polarisation on social media with a school class, rehearse a negotiation in a leadership workshop, or play historical characters in a museum.

highlights.title: Insight Into Group Dynamics
highlights.description: Add a data layer that records votes, opinion shifts, and participation per role, giving trainers and teachers a clear basis for the debrief.

highlights.title: Roles Within a Bigger Story
highlights.description: Pair with Personality Quiz to assign roles that fit each person, with Live Quiz Show to follow up with a knowledge round, or with Laser Voting to bring the final vote onto the big screen.
